extraction_precision.note: Unchosen on purpose. The bar is set against the first run over the labelled corpus, and thereafter tightens only. docs/12-evaluation.md, Open.

retrieval_precision_under_budget.note: Phase 2. No corpus of labelled queries exists yet.

reconciliation_false_positive_rate.note: The kill metric. Any run at or above the bar fails regardless of the baseline, and the bar tightens only. docs/14-roadmap.md.

ratification_throughput.note: Phase 4. Computed from atom_events in a real tenant, not from a corpus.
